title: Origin DE
description: The Origin: Edition datapack adds unique races to Minecraft: Terraborn gain strength at high altitudes and speed on grass, while Werewolves become powerful nocturnal hunters with massive combat buffs at night. Which playstyle suits you better?
body:
Step into a new identity with Origin Datapack: Edition!
This datapack brings a strategic race system to your Minecraft world. Your
Available Races:
🌿 Terraborn
The guardians of the surface. Their power grows the higher they climb
Altitude Power: Gain powerful status effects when standing above Y=50.
Nature’s Grace: Receive additional movement and speed buffs while walking on grass.
🐺 Werewolf
A cursed (or blessed) lineage of hunters. While they appear normal by
Nocturnal Predator: Gain massive combat and survival buffs during the night.
Tip: Use the darkness to your advantage to outrun and outfight your
Commands:
To choose your race, use the following simple triggers:
/trigger terraborn — Become a Terraborn.
/trigger werewolf — Become a Werewolf.
